name: Full cached southern Manhattan OSM network
source_description: SALT cached OSM south-Manhattan topology; stationary ECC delay overlay
upstream_parallel_edge_rule: Minimum nominal travel-time parallel edge; node ids sorted
osm_snapshot_date: Not recorded in the cached export; not a current-map claim.
selection: Full parent graph without geographic cropping, then largest strongly connected component; no added reverse edges.
travel_time_model: Independent Uniform(free, free + delay_width) for every traversal. Synthetic stationary noise; not measured traffic.
delay_width_rule: free_flow_minutes * congestion_amplitude + red_window_seconds / 60 from the parent synthetic overlay; red_probability is not used.
